title: Installation Jobs: Flashing Inspection Hold-Back in Crew Planning
content:
**Flashing inspection hold-back — Installation Jobs crew planning**

For the mid-job flashing inspection of a permitted **Installation Jobs** record, the crew holds back capacity, counted in openings that join the units the crew plans for.

| Job's charges | Units the job installs | Inspection hold-back |
|---|---|---|
| carry the permit administration fee | more than 15 | 2 openings |
| carry the permit administration fee | 15 or fewer | 1 opening |
| do not carry the permit administration fee | any | none |

Whether the job's charges carry the permit administration fee is read from the job charges recorded on the job: a job charge of kind permit administration fee on that job.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical jobs)

| Permit administration fee among the job's charges | Units | Hold-back |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 16 | 2 openings |
| yes | 15 | 1 opening |
| no | 22 | none |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A job of 15 units whose charges carry the permit administration fee counts its 15 units plus a hold-back of 1 opening, 16 openings in all, when its crew days are planned. A job of 16 units with the fee among its charges counts 16 plus 2, that is 18 openings. Either job with no permit administration fee among its charges counts its units alone.
